questions.question: Which evidence supports a consistent restart boundary?
options: The next IDs, losses and full training state match the uninterrupted future under a compatible contract.
questions.explanation: A consistent restart preserves both data position and transition state, not just a readable file or a favorable metric.
optionFeedback: A directory can be incomplete or contain mismatched components. Wait for completion, validate metadata and compare continuation.
